result.Method of Attack: Namesquatting legitimate npm packages with backdoored copies containing obfuscated BeaverTail malware; Delivery of BeaverTail JavaScript infostealer and downloader malware; Exfiltration of cryptocurrency wallets, credit card info, and macOS Login Keychain data; Downloading and running second-stage Python backdoor InvisibleFerret from attacker-controlled C2 servers
result.Impacted Systems: Node.js developer environments; Unix and Windows systems with affected npm packages installed
result.Attack Vector: Malicious npm packages published via namesquatting; Obfuscated JavaScript code embedded in backdoored packages; Distribution through npm registry targeting developers
result.Indicators of Compromise: IP address 95.164.17[.]24 on port 1224 used for data exfiltration and InvisibleFerret download; Obfuscated JavaScript code lines in packages passports-js, bcrypts-js, and blockscan-api; Campaign ID 726 in C2 URLs; NPM author superdev727 (austin27ahn@outlook.com); URLs with structure /uploads, /pdown, /client/<integer>/<3 digit campaign ID> on C2 server; GitHub Security Advisories released for all three packages
